answer: By bonding stake to a per-epoch identity island, the protocol prices each Sybil cluster as a distinct coalition whose deviation payoff is bounded by AMM slippage decay. A copper-weighted reputation ledger then tracks stake migration across epochs, so colluders cannot ride the tide of wash identities without decaying their own subgame-perfect equilibrium share. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
